title: Smart Attendance
description: Daily attendance system with a live date/clock header students use to mark present with a 13-digit student ID. Records save through a Google Apps Script backend backed by Google Sheets, while the on-page "Today's Attendance" table updates live with masked IDs and timestamps. Ships with English/Bangla language toggle and dark/light themes.
